upgrades.name: Auxiliary Power
upgrades.tooltip: Brings ship systems online every run. Spend power cells on their talents; both reset when you extract.

upgrades.name: Command Center
upgrades.tooltip: Unlocks fleet commands.

upgrades.name: Overloaded Holds
upgrades.tooltip: Double fleet cargo, but loaded ships burn fuel twice as fast.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Empty ships use fuel as normal.

upgrades.name: Fleet Requisition
upgrades.tooltip: One free ship for every five of a type.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Drones don't count as fleet ships.

upgrades.name: Deep-Core Munitions
upgrades.tooltip: Weapons reach a layer deeper but throw gems 40% farther.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Better gem colors, not more gems.

upgrades.name: Target Painter
upgrades.tooltip: Click the planet to paint a target. Automatic weapons aim there for double gems, but fire at 65% speed.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Repainting refreshes the target.

upgrades.name: Cargo Catapult
upgrades.tooltip: Every 250 gems delivered, the home base hurls a slug at the planet that hits like five cannon shots.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Slugs count as cannon hits for cannon upgrades.

upgrades.name: Combined Arms
upgrades.tooltip: Each automatic weapon you own boosts all of them by 20%.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: With all four weapons online, each produces 60% more gems.

upgrades.name: Project Constellation
upgrades.tooltip: Rockets wait in orbit until the Railgun fires, then strike its impact point with 50% more payload.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Up to 64 rockets wait in orbit. Without a Railgun they launch after 12 seconds.

upgrades.name: Command Chain
upgrades.tooltip: Using a fleet command cuts 25% off the other commands' cooldowns.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Command Center.

upgrades.name: Multicast Mastery
upgrades.tooltip: Unlocks triple, quadruple and quintuple ship system echoes.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Multicast Protocol.

upgrades.name: Command Nexus
upgrades.tooltip: All fleet commands unlock at the start of a run and recharge 30% faster.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Command Center.

upgrades.name: Weaponized Compression
upgrades.tooltip: Merged gems are worth twice their combined value.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Matter Compression.

upgrades.name: System Cooldowns
upgrades.tooltip: Ship systems recharge faster.

upgrades.name: Multicast Protocol
upgrades.tooltip: Ship systems have a 10% chance to fire twice.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Extra casts follow 0.25 seconds apart and can't multicast again.

upgrades.name: Multicast Power
upgrades.tooltip: Better multicast chances and higher cast counts.

upgrades.name: Gem Value
upgrades.tooltip: Gems are worth more.

upgrades.name: Gem Value Multiplier
upgrades.tooltip: Multiplies gem value.

upgrades.name: Matter Compression
upgrades.tooltip: Five nearby gems merge into one holding their combined value.

upgrades.name: Gem Merger Bonus
upgrades.tooltip: Merged gems gain bonus value.

upgrades.name: Gem Merger Multiplier
upgrades.tooltip: Merged gems are worth more.

upgrades.name: All Harvester Speed
upgrades.tooltip: All fleet ships fly faster.

upgrades.name: Dimensional Cargo Bays
upgrades.tooltip: All fleet ships carry more.

upgrades.name: Tractor Matrix
upgrades.tooltip: All fleet ships collect from farther away.

upgrades.name: Antimatter Tanks
upgrades.tooltip: All fleet ships hold more fuel.

upgrades.name: Closed-Cycle Drives
upgrades.tooltip: All fleet ships burn less fuel.

upgrades.name: Recall Engines
upgrades.tooltip: Full ships fly home faster.

upgrades.name: Fleet Refinery
upgrades.tooltip: Multiplies the value of every fleet delivery.

upgrades.name: Jackpot Haul
upgrades.tooltip: Deliveries have a 5% chance to pay out 5x, and a rare chance to pay out 10x.

upgrades.name: Resonance Cascade
upgrades.tooltip: Every 50 fleet pickups, ships gain +75% speed and +25% range for 6 seconds.

upgrades.name: Quantum Entanglement
upgrades.tooltip: Ships are paired: each gem collected sends 25% of its value to the partner ship.

upgrades.name: Phase Logistics
upgrades.tooltip: Ships send every gem straight home at 75% value, skipping return trips.

upgrades.name: Ability Slot
upgrades.tooltip: One more ability slot.

upgrades.name: Shipyard
upgrades.tooltip: Salvage modules during runs and fit them to your fleet. Modules are lost when you extract.

upgrades.name: Module Bays
upgrades.tooltip: One more module slot for every ship type, up to 4.

upgrades.name: Deep Space Signals
upgrades.tooltip: Unlocks scans for permanent signal bonuses.

upgrades.name: Command Amplifier
upgrades.tooltip: Fleet commands are 20% stronger per rank.

upgrades.name: Precision Harvest
upgrades.tooltip: +100% click value per rank.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Multiplies with run upgrades and signals.

upgrades.name: Wide Survey
upgrades.tooltip: Doubles your click radius and the gravity well's radius.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Stacks with run upgrades and signals.

upgrades.name: Quantum Touch
upgrades.tooltip: Each click also collects up to 32 gems at the mirrored spot across the home base.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Works with Sustained Harvest. Mirrored pickups don't repeat Gem Link or shockwaves.

upgrades.name: Event Horizon
upgrades.tooltip: The gravity well's core harvests gems at double click value.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Gravity Well in the run tree.

upgrades.name: Gravity Mastery
upgrades.tooltip: Hold right-click to steer the gravity well. Its core harvests gems at double click value.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Gravity Well in the run tree.

upgrades.name: Singularity Collapse
upgrades.tooltip: The gravity well detonates when it ends, harvesting up to 128 gems at triple click value.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Gravity Well in the run tree. Canceling the well doesn't detonate it.

upgrades.name: Planet Cracker Core
upgrades.tooltip: Planet Cracker knocks 10% more gems loose per rank.

upgrades.name: Combo Supernova
upgrades.tooltip: Every fifth combo click releases a supernova that harvests up to 32 gems at triple value.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Sustained Harvest also builds toward the supernova.

upgrades.name: Thermite Rounds
upgrades.tooltip: Cannon hits leave molten craters that deal half the damage again over 4 seconds. Magma Scars last twice as long.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Rockets and the Railgun set craters off with Magma Detonation.

upgrades.name: Lightning Rod
upgrades.tooltip: While the harpoon is anchored, cannon hits add extra pulses. Between anchors it reloads twice as fast.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Arc Harpoon in the run tree.

upgrades.name: Beam Riders
upgrades.tooltip: Each laser beam fires a rocket every 3 seconds. Beam rockets use every rocket upgrade.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Mining Laser and Rocket Pods in the run tree. More beams fire more rockets.

upgrades.name: Magma Detonation
upgrades.tooltip: Rocket and Railgun hits detonate nearby molten scars and craters for double their remaining damage.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Chain Reaction makes detonations spread.

upgrades.name: Echo Protocol
upgrades.tooltip: Ship systems have a 25% chance to fire twice, and every activation fires a three-shell cannon volley.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Auxiliary Power. Volleys use the cannon's fire power and specials.

upgrades.name: Main Battery Relay
upgrades.tooltip: When the Railgun fires, every other weapon fires with it.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Railgun in the run tree. Only weapons you own fire.

upgrades.name: Drone Gunships
upgrades.tooltip: Drones fire a cannon shell at the planet when they launch and when their time runs out.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Auxiliary Power and Drone Swarm. Shells use the cannon's fire power and specials.

upgrades.name: Kamikaze Drones
upgrades.tooltip: Replaces the Drone Swarm with the Kamikaze Wing: bombers that dive into the planet and detonate.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Auxiliary Power. Drone signals apply to the wing, and blasts count as rocket hits.

upgrades.name: Shard Reactor
upgrades.tooltip: Each Core Shard you hold adds 20% weapon damage. Collecting one doubles fire rate for 20 seconds.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Spend shards on upgrades, or hold them for damage.

upgrades.name: Signal Resonance
upgrades.tooltip: Each signal you own adds 1% weapon damage, up to 100%. Every 25 signals reach one layer deeper.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Every signal stack counts.

upgrades.name: Planetary Overload
upgrades.tooltip: Damage builds pressure in the planet. At full pressure it erupts and every weapon fires at once.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: The planet glows as pressure builds. It erupts at most every 8 seconds.

upgrades.name: Armed Escorts
upgrades.tooltip: Each delivery fires a cannon shell for every module the ship carries.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Shipyard. Shells use the cannon's fire power and specials.

upgrades.name: Prismatic Lens
upgrades.tooltip: Laser beams split in two at half strength: same damage, twice the scars and Beam Riders.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Twin and Quad Lasers split too, up to eight beams.

upgrades.name: Shrapnel Shell
upgrades.tooltip: The shell takes double damage and leaves molten craters when it shatters.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Magma Detonation and Tesla Coil can set the craters off.

upgrades.name: Overdrive Protocol
upgrades.tooltip: While Overdrive runs, every weapon fires twice as fast.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Command Center.

upgrades.name: Sympathetic Fire
upgrades.tooltip: Laser hits can launch a rocket (5%) or fire the Railgun (1%).
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Mining Laser, and Rocket Pods or the Railgun.

upgrades.name: Kinetic Harvest
upgrades.tooltip: Each gem you collect by hand charges the Railgun by 0.5%.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Railgun in the run tree. Every gem you collect by hand counts.

upgrades.name: Recoil Harvest
upgrades.tooltip: For 3 seconds after each Railgun round, gems you collect by hand are worth three times as much.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Counts clicks and the gravity well. Requires Railgun in the run tree.

upgrades.name: Kinetic Battery
upgrades.tooltip: Each gem you collect by hand adds 1% damage to the next Railgun round, up to 200%.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: The stored bonus goes into the next round the Railgun fires. Requires Railgun in the run tree.

upgrades.name: Ionized Magma
upgrades.tooltip: Molten scars and craters conduct: harpoon pulses arc to the ones near the anchor, and each arc keeps a spot molten a second longer.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: With Tesla Coil, pulses arc to molten spots all over the planet. Requires Arc Harpoon in the run tree.

upgrades.name: Galvanic Shock
upgrades.tooltip: Harpoon pulses and arcs have a 5% chance to crit for five times the damage. Each crit shocks the planet: 1% more damage from everything for 2 seconds, stacking up to 200%.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Arcs come from Tesla Coil, Ionized Magma, Arc Lance and Conductor Round.

upgrades.name: Deadeye
upgrades.tooltip: Every weapon hit has a 5% chance to crit for five times the damage.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Adds to Critical Shells and Galvanic Shock. Crit chance from every source stacks.

upgrades.name: Hot Streak
upgrades.tooltip: Each crit adds 1% crit chance to every weapon for 4 seconds, stacking up to 50%.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Needs crits to get going: Deadeye, Critical Shells or Galvanic Shock.

upgrades.name: Critical Mass
upgrades.tooltip: Every crit fires a free plasma shell at the spot it hit. Those shells can crit too.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Up to twelve shells a second.

upgrades.name: Executioner
upgrades.tooltip: Crits deal ten times the damage instead of five.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Every crit in the game, lightning included.

upgrades.name: Jackpot
upgrades.tooltip: One crit in fifty is a jackpot: a hundred times the damage, and the whole planet shakes.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Counts every crit, from every weapon.

upgrades.name: Fault Seeding
upgrades.tooltip: Genesis Pulse seeds weak points on the planet. The first hit on one deals twenty times the damage.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Auxiliary Power and Genesis Pulse.

upgrades.name: Drill Spotter
upgrades.tooltip: Automatic weapons aim at the drill's bore hole, and half their damage there feeds the drill.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Requires Auxiliary Power and Core Drill. A bigger drill total makes Core Tap bigger.

upgrades.name: Chain Reaction
upgrades.tooltip: Detonations set off nearby molten spots, rippling across the planet.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Works with every kind of detonation.

upgrades.name: Magma Reservoir
upgrades.tooltip: Molten craters and magma scars burn 50% longer, dealing 50% more damage, and twice as many can burn at once.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: When too many burn, the oldest goes out early with damage it had left. Gives Magma Detonation and Ionized Magma more to work with.

upgrades.name: Molten Core
upgrades.tooltip: Each core fracture fills the new crack with eight molten craters.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Magma Detonation, Chain Reaction and Tesla Coil can set them off.

upgrades.name: Overclock
upgrades.tooltip: Weapons fire twice as fast but deal half damage.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Same damage per second, but per-hit effects trigger twice as often.

upgrades.name: Heavy Ordnance
upgrades.tooltip: Weapons fire half as fast, but each hit deals double damage and reaches a layer deeper.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Same damage per second in fewer, bigger hits that dig up better gem colors.

upgrades.name: Lone Operator
upgrades.tooltip: Your fleet stays docked. Clicks and the gravity well collect five times the value, and your shots hit five times as hard.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Fleet upgrades and the Shipyard do nothing. Drones still fly.

upgrades.name: Resonant Core
upgrades.tooltip: Every 10 seconds, a quake deals 5% of the last minute's damage again.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: The quake's damage counts toward the next resonance.

upgrades.name: Core Breaker
upgrades.tooltip: Core fractures need half as much damage per minute.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: More fractures mean more Core Shards.

upgrades.name: Expand Space
upgrades.tooltip: The field grows wider.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Claimed after your first core extraction.

upgrades.name: Spare Cells
upgrades.tooltip: Start every run with 2 power cells.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Needs Auxiliary Power.

upgrades.name: Head Start
upgrades.tooltip: Start every run with 10,000 gems.
upgrades.tooltip_extra: Starting gems don't count toward the extraction reward.

upgrades.name: Shard Cache
upgrades.tooltip: Start every run with a Core Shard.

upgrades.name: Core Memory
upgrades.tooltip: Every run starts with the planet's shell already broken.
